status: Curated reusable bioinformatics thought patterns; selecting a pattern does not award credit or supply a tool implementation.

scope.review_basis: Questions, recorded observations and consequences across all 142 groups; relevant original traces and complete modularity findings for selected entries. This curation is not a fresh reread of all primary papers.
scope.selection_meaning: One selected entry narrows the child episode’s fixed decision problem and guides several evolving turns. The episode can change its next comparison as outcomes arrive. A different thought pattern or tool set belongs to a separately commissioned child prepared through process.revise; it does not replace the current episode’s selection or history.
scope.experimental_owner: All biological experiments are author-reported; actual earlier research operations retain their recorded limits.
scope.overlap_policy: Entries may bear on the same case but distinguish competing relations. No mandatory order or universal compatibility is implied.
scope.available_work: Use existing biological records and actual callable computations supplied in the scoped tool slot. Author experiments support reasoning options; mentioning a perturbation or assay does not make a new experiment executable. If the discriminating observation is unavailable, preserve the unresolved alternatives and identify the missing evidence.
scope.literature_boundary: Published cases are provenance for biological reasoning. Search strategies, source/page/table reading workflows and LiteratureEpisodes are not thought-pattern entries in this catalog.

options.name: Choose a relevant analogue and bound what transfers
options.description: Use similarity to a characterized system to form bounded explanations. Choose which sequence, local structural machinery, domain architecture, genomic context or organismal circumstance makes the reference informative for the disputed property; revise misleading comparators.
options.use_when: A nearest hit, fold, motif or similar biological context suggests an annotation, but exact chemistry, recognition or role remains open.
live_alternatives: A relevant shared relationship supports transfer of the disputed property.
Only a partial core is shared; recognition, partners or role differ.
The comparator or short match is uninformative for this question.
decision_guidance: Prefer references that separate plausible alternatives, not simply the most familiar name or highest global score. Alignments, structures and context searches are ways to inspect a chosen relationship.
When a comparison is weak, consider a biologically better reference before treating it as evidence against all relationship.
Keep catalytic compatibility, target recognition and native role as separate transfer claims; absent catalytic machinery can overturn an inherited chemistry.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Relevant machinery corresponds but specificity differs
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain the supported relationship and investigate the differing recognition or contextual features.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Expected catalytic machinery is incompatible
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Reopen chemistry and preserve only the relationship actually supported.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: No informative correspondence is found
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Keep function unresolved; absence of an informative match is not absence of function.

options.boundary: Choose a comparator for transfer of a disputed biological property. P02 instead tests an explicit feature-to-function implication against discordant cases. A better sequence score, fold match or neighborhood is a tool result, not the transfer conclusion.

evidence.source_locator: Primary active-site comparison; sequence/hemk_live_routes.json A1–A3.
evidence.observation: Dam supplied a poor motif comparison; the more relevant M.TaqI comparison supported related active-site geometry without specifying DNA versus protein substrate.
evidence.limit: Fresh raw scores were uncalibrated and answer-aware; the structural comparison is author-reported.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Read relevant primary results and methods; live deposited binding-site API retrievals. Original API URLs lacking entity ID returned 404 and were repaired using current PDBe documentation. No repository changes or scientific-case runs.
evidence.observation: Cytosine-deaminase-like machinery supported a coarse relationship; substrate tests established another specificity.
evidence.limit: The fold and contact queries do not identify the dominant physiological substrate.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary abstract, genetic results, direct-subunit investigation and discussion inspected through indexed full-text sections. No new comparative genomics run.
evidence.observation: HisRS-like ancestry did not imply tRNA charging: HisZ instead contributed with HisG to histidine biosynthesis.
evidence.limit: Genetics/biochemistry are author-performed; no new evolutionary reconstruction.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary PNAS abstract plus NAR substrate-preparation methods and Q34 comparison results inspected. No live tRNA or protein calculation.
evidence.observation: Missing recognition architecture and matched tRNA tests redirected a GluRS-like comparison toward queuosine modification.
evidence.limit: PNAS source was abstract-level; matched Q34 tests were read in the NAR paper.

options.name: Seek cases that break a proposed predictor
options.description: Treat an implication as something that can fail. Prefer feature/function discordance: feature without function challenges sufficiency; function without feature challenges necessity.
options.use_when: An annotation is extended using a residue, motif, similarity rank, genomic partner or contact as a predictor.
live_alternatives: The feature is sufficient, necessary, both or merely correlated in the relevant domain.
Discordance is a real exception.
Apparent discordance reflects incomplete measurement or an inapplicable assay.
decision_guidance: Name the feature-to-function implication before selecting a comparison. Seek informative discordance rather than additional concordant relatives.
Keep blank genomic fields, assay limits and failed complementation distinct; none can silently become another kind of negative.
Compare alternative recognition or contextual explanations after an exception, without treating a post-hoc explanation as a validated replacement rule.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Feature-positive/function-negative is established
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Narrow sufficiency without automatically rejecting necessity.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Feature-negative/function-positive is established
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Narrow necessity while retaining uncertainty about alternative mechanisms.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: The supposed negative is unmeasured or inapplicable
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain unresolved status and seek an informative comparator.

options.boundary: A feature/function counterexample tests an implication without establishing classifier accuracy. P01 bounds transfer from an analogue; P17 additionally requires evidence that a causal perturbation selectively changed one property while relevant alternatives survived. Natural discordance alone does not establish causal selectivity.

evidence.source_locator: Primary Table 3 and motif Results; comparison/counterexample_calculations.json.
evidence.observation: A higher-scoring motif-deficient candidate failed complementation while lower-scoring motif-bearing candidates succeeded.
evidence.limit: Selected comparisons are not a classifier benchmark; expression and host effects remain alternatives.

evidence.source_locator: Primary Table 1 and SAH discussion; comparison/counterexample_calculations.json.
evidence.observation: Arginine-positive Bc1793 lacked measured SAH activity; Tvn0515 lacked template arginines yet had SAH activity.
evidence.limit: Censored efficiencies remain bounds; loop/contact explanations were modeled.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary introduction, sequence results, substrate table and competition methods/results inspected through indexed full text. Historical organism name preserved explicitly.
evidence.observation: Nine differences in 475 residues accompanied different substrate chemistry, defeating near identity as a sufficient specificity rule.
evidence.limit: The study did not establish a universal specificity rule for the nine substitutions.

evidence.source_locator: Selected-transcript processing Results; cellular/detailed_traces.json route B.
evidence.observation: Selected RNA ends were lost while rnpB behaved differently from the rny mutant, challenging a uniform RNase Y dependency.
evidence.limit: Processed tracks were extracted descriptively; end-chemistry validation was author-performed.

options.name: Discriminate competing inputs by their predicted chemistry
options.description: Keep the candidate system explicit while choosing substrates, co-substrates or acceptors that distinguish competing recognition hypotheses. Refine the candidate space using identified products and bounded non-products.
options.use_when: Several chemically plausible inputs remain and another family match will not distinguish them.
live_alternatives: Candidate inputs differ at a recognized chemical feature.
A side reaction is being mistaken for the preferred reaction.
Apparent specificity belongs to another preparation component or coupled partner.
decision_guidance: Choose contrasts changing the feature on which the hypotheses disagree, including close analogues and plausible pathway inputs.
Positives may motivate adjacent candidates omitted from the initial library; unavailable compounds remain untested.
Interpret the profile at the level of the assayed preparation with conditions and product identity retained; component attribution may need P06.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: A coherent product pattern supports one recognition hypothesis
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Narrow the tested profile and choose an informative untested boundary.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: An attractive input fails under competent conditions
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Revise input recognition without discarding every supported catalytic relationship.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Comparative kinetics or products are missing
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Report bounded capacity rather than rank untested native inputs.

options.boundary: The unknown is which input or recognized chemical feature differentiates candidate reactions in a fixed system. P14 instead asks what transformation actually occurred; P06 asks which component caused it; P11 asks whether the measured capacity is used natively. A proposed assay panel is not an available tool or an instruction to perform new experiments.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Read relevant primary results and methods; live deposited binding-site API retrievals. Original API URLs lacking entity ID returned 404 and were repaired using current PDBe documentation. No repository changes or scientific-case runs.
evidence.observation: Cytosine derivatives failed while SAH/MTA/adenosine reacted; AMP was a docking false positive and SAM did not turn over.
evidence.limit: Published author assays; no docking or screening rerun.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Complete main paper, genome-analysis methods, results, and substrate-assay methods read. No WIT reconstruction, alignment, or enzyme assay rerun. Historical WIT identifier retained without an unverified modern-locus mapping.
evidence.observation: Shikimate-versus-homoserine panels distinguished two GHMP-like paralogs despite family resemblance.
evidence.limit: Context prioritized candidates; author assays established the specificity.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2008 primary relevant full methods/results/discussion inspected. 2010 CysQ deletion, extract-activity and discussion sections inspected; no genome analysis of putative suppressors.
evidence.observation: PAP kinetics contrasted with over 1,000-fold weaker IMP/FBP efficiencies, exposing a preferred substrate omitted from the old interpretation.
evidence.limit: PAP/PAPS assay limits remain; native flux was not measured.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2021 primary full text inspected, 2014 and 2008 references screened at primary abstract level; raw 2021 XML retained.
evidence.observation: Sulfosugar versus ordinary-sugar/phosphosugar comparisons constrained cross-use despite parallel pathway organization.
evidence.limit: Cross-paper comparisons retain organism/assay context; spectra were not independently reprocessed.

options.name: Revise the failed attachment while retaining independent constraints
options.description: After a competent negative or contradiction, separate the part of the explanation that failed from independently supported constraints. Reopen alternatives within surviving constraints without either preserving the whole annotation or discarding everything.
options.use_when: A reaction or familiar-function assignment fails while pathway placement or another biological association remains supported.
live_alternatives: The reaction was wrong but independent placement survives.
The association itself was misleading.
The test was not competent to evaluate the proposed function.
decision_guidance: Identify independent support for each part of the old explanation before deciding what survives.
Use surviving branch boundaries, required chemistry and distribution to construct a limited alternative set.
Preserve association-only wording when no exact replacement reaction is established.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Reaction fails but independent placement survives
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Investigate a different compatible transformation.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: A new identified product establishes an alternative
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Replace the failed reaction while retaining unresolved mechanism/native-use questions.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: No alternative is established
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Return the supported association and explicit unresolved claims.

options.boundary: The starting state is a failed or contradicted attachment to an existing explanation, with independent surviving constraints. P05 starts from a supported system requirement without an assigned contribution. No old claim survives merely because it was recorded; failed expression or retrieval is not a negative activity result.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary Results and Discussion plus alignment and assay descriptions inspected through indexed full-text sections. No sequence alignment or experiments rerun here.
evidence.observation: Controlled cyclohydrolase negatives led authors to later queuosine reductions; branch placement survived and preQ0 reduction was established.
evidence.limit: Sequence/context records are one case; motif absence did not identify the product.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Complete primary methods/results and pathway caveats read. No assay or genomic analysis rerun; historical whole-pathway claims not promoted to a current confirmed pathway.
evidence.observation: Mevalonate/phosphomevalonate negatives left isoprenoid context intact and motivated a different reaction order.
evidence.limit: The historical proposed complete pathway remained a separate hypothesis.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Complete primary methods/results read through Europe PMC XML; deposited XLSX parsed; actual ENA genome record retrieved. No annotation run or experiment performed. Table and experimental strains were kept distinct.
evidence.observation: Thiamin-linked context survived tested salvage failures while exact substrate/reaction stayed unassigned.
evidence.limit: Read-only context probes were descriptive; blank FmnO assignments are not proven absence.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2013 main narrative, modeling assumptions and stated assay outcomes inspected; detailed supplementary assay protocols not independently checked. 2019 complete relevant activity/results/discussion and assay conditions inspected. Original 2011 paper not newly verified.
evidence.observation: Failure to reproduce PDC justified dropping that established-function claim without declaring a native esterase solution.
evidence.limit: Later artificial-ester activity did not settle native function.

options.name: Constrain missing-function hypotheses by what the system must accomplish
options.description: Use a supported output or requirement to distinguish loss of function, unfamiliar replacement, different route and changed demand. Evaluate candidate similarities and context against these system explanations.
options.use_when: A familiar enzyme is missing or a required conversion has no assigned protein despite evidence that the output exists or is needed.
live_alternatives: Capability is absent or supplied environmentally.
An unfamiliar protein supplies the same contribution.
A different route reaches the output or bypasses the requirement.
The presumed system requirement is wrong here.
decision_guidance: Specify the required input/output or demand before choosing families.
Prefer distribution, domain combinations and context distinguishing explanations, including pathway-negative organisms when available.
Allow an alternative to change the reaction boundary; replacement need not copy every activity of the familiar protein.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Candidate tracks the contribution and functional evidence agrees
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Support the demonstrated contribution; association alone remains a candidate assignment.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Output persists without the familiar route
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain replacement and bypass alternatives.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Only a missing label or textbook gap exists
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Keep completion provisional instead of assigning a gene to fill a diagram.

options.boundary: The starting state is a missing explanation for a supported system output or demand, not merely an empty gene label. P04 reopens a failed assignment; P19 explains output retained after a focal loss; P07 explains an endpoint improved by an intervention. This is system-level abduction, not a gene-search task or one-gene-per-step rule.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Complete main paper, genome-analysis methods, results, and substrate-assay methods read. No WIT reconstruction, alignment, or enzyme assay rerun. Historical WIT identifier retained without an unverified modern-locus mapping.
evidence.observation: Missing recognizable kinase, contrasting pathway-bearing archaea and contextual GHMP paralogs narrowed a nonorthologous replacement.
evidence.limit: Context and direct substrate assays support different claims.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Complete short primary paper and methods read. No ribB-neighborhood retrieval or enzymatic measurement repeated.
evidence.observation: A CTP-preferring archaeal kinase supplied missing riboflavin phosphorylation despite no recognizable canonical sequence.
evidence.limit: Auxotroph occurrence also permits salvage; fold/CDP binding alone would not establish the assignment.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary results for purification, nucleotide preference, NMR and the database-search narrative inspected through indexed full-text sections; no live pathway analysis.
evidence.observation: Observed CTP-dependent pathway chemistry guided a chemical-class/domain search followed by recombinant product validation.
evidence.limit: The search rationale is author-reported; no new pathway analysis or assay.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Full relevant primary results/methods in both papers; independent read-only 7LC5 coordinate probe recorded separately. No cultures, mass-spectrometric assays or mechanism reconstruction rerun.
evidence.observation: Q persisted despite missing QueG; distributions, context and cellular product tests identified an alternative contribution.
evidence.limit: Cellular evidence does not settle isolated productive catalysis or native cofactors.

options.name: Retain the system output and revise who contributes what
options.description: Keep a real aggregate output separate from its attribution. Compare direct chemistry, substrate/cofactor supply, enabling a complex, downstream filtering and production of an observable signal.
options.use_when: A mixture, complex or cellular endpoint is being used to assign the intended component a molecular job.
live_alternatives: The nominated component performs the transformation.
It enables or supplies another contributor.
A partner or contaminant creates/filters the signal.
The output is real but its source remains unresolved.
decision_guidance: Choose a comparison separating the live contributor assignments while preserving relevant system competence.
Independent preparation, selective partner changes, defined systems or positive structural roles can update attribution; no layout is mandatory.
Keep the genuine output after attribution fails, and seek a positive contribution rather than an empty scaffold label.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Changing a downstream partner changes apparent upstream specificity
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Bound the result to the coupled pair.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Activity follows an identified host protein instead of the intended construct
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Reassign the activity while leaving the original candidate unresolved.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Positive evidence separates catalytic and enabling roles
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Assign bounded distinct contributions; unvalidated catalytic-null labels cannot prove dispensability.

options.boundary: The system output is accepted at its measured scope; the disputed relation is who contributes what. P14 instead disputes the identity of the transformation. P10 disputes the coupled chemical account. P02/P17 address predictor validity or selective necessity rather than assigning all mixture output to its named component.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary complete indexed narrative, purification table, peptide-ID results and recombinant assays inspected. No wet-lab work performed.
evidence.observation: Extract activity lacked the intended archaeal candidate’s expected behavior; purification and independently prepared CodA identified a host contribution.
evidence.limit: Insolubility was not a negative activity measurement for the archaeal protein.

evidence.source_locator: Role of CofD in substrate specificity Results, combined-assay Methods and Discussion.
evidence.observation: Changing only CofD/FbiA changed the coupled system’s apparent precursor preference.
evidence.limit: The published assays were not rerun; upstream specificity cannot be isolated from final product alone.

evidence.source_locator: Protospacer integration Results, Fig. 1 and Extended Data Figs. 2–3; C3 in causal/cas2/case_trace.json.
evidence.observation: Defined integration and complex comparisons distinguish Cas1 chemistry from Cas2 enabling contributions.
evidence.limit: E. coli E9 mutants were not directly validated nuclease-null; coordinate geometry alone proves neither necessity nor energy.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary relevant complete results/discussion and reconstitution/NMR/purification methods inspected. Supplement MS identification accepted as reported; its underlying spectra were not reanalyzed. Current PDB polymer records bind HFP to aq_1744/O67630; gpmA is a record label, not independent mutase evidence.
evidence.observation: Apparent HFP isomerase also appeared in other preparations and host RpiA was detected; phosphatase-compatible activity survived.
evidence.limit: Supplement MS identification is author-reported; native essentiality was not established.

options.name: Distinguish restoration from bypass, compensation and reduced demand
options.description: An improved endpoint can repair the proposed molecular relationship, use another route, reduce demand or change downstream consequences. Compare those explanations before treating rescue as mechanistic equivalence.
options.use_when: Complementation, suppressors, adaptive recovery or supplementation improve an endpoint after a focal loss.
live_alternatives: The original molecular contribution is restored.
Another route reaches the endpoint.
Demand for the contribution is reduced.
Only a downstream consequence improves.
decision_guidance: Name the molecular defect rescue is supposed to repair, then seek a comparison separating repair from endpoint compensation.
Multi-step bypass, reintroduced lost functions and separate molecular readouts can distinguish the alternatives.
Restrict equivalence to the contribution/conditions restored; donor expression does not establish ordinary native role.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Endpoint recovers while proposed catalytic defect persists
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain compensation or bypass rather than claim molecular repair.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Replacement bypasses several steps or changes cofactor demand
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Assign the alternative route instead of copying the missing-enzyme name.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Only some outcomes are restored
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Represent partial/conditional substitution.

options.boundary: The starting observation is an endpoint improved by rescue, suppression or compensation. The unknown is whether the original molecular contribution was restored. P19 starts from output that never disappeared after focal loss; P05 starts from an unassigned requirement. Positive rescue does not by itself establish isolated chemistry or full reference-function equivalence.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Main relevant Results/Methods read; no independent raw spectral or isotope analysis.
evidence.observation: BioZ bypassed both BioC and BioH through another pimeloyl-ACP entry route.
evidence.limit: All native and biochemical tests are author-performed.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Relevant full Results/Methods and figure descriptions read; no evolution, raw sequencing or omics reanalysis.
evidence.observation: Some trajectories partially restored DHFR; others changed thyA/deoB and retained supplement dependence.
evidence.limit: Suppressor lineages were not all supplement-independent; evolution was not rerun.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2010 primary abstract and indexed Results snippets checked; 2013 primary full Results, rescue and competition experiments examined. Original full 2010 article not obtained.
evidence.observation: YihI improved derT57I growth without restoring the tested purified GTPase defect.
evidence.limit: No unique compensating mechanism was established.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Complete main Results and relevant Methods read; reported assay negatives remain condition-bounded.
evidence.observation: CobY replaced guanylyltransferase demand but not the kinase demand of the tested salvage route.
evidence.limit: This does not establish bifunctional CobU equivalence.

options.name: Test the missing prerequisite behind conditional function
options.description: Investigate which enabling resource or molecular state permits a supported capability to matter. Distinguish that prerequisite from correlated stress, altered protein amount and reporter failure.
options.use_when: A preparation is inactive or a gene dispensable in one setting despite evidence for a contribution elsewhere.
live_alternatives: A missing cofactor, partner, nutrient, acceptor or resource context enables the function.
The capability is absent or irrelevant.
The condition changes abundance, another route or reporter competence instead.
decision_guidance: Choose a motivated prerequisite for which the competing explanations predict different outcomes; arbitrary condition variation is insufficient.
Contrast focal genotype/protein state across independently varied prerequisite states with identity and competence controls.
A successful addition needs molecular/identity evidence before being called direct catalysis or sensing.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Independent resource-generating changes alter both resource and genotype-specific benefit
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Support resource-conditioned contribution.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Cofactor-complete preparation gains identified activity
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Do not use incomplete preparation as functional falsification; keep native delivery unknown.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Only abundance or reporter competence changes
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain indirect alternatives.

options.boundary: The unknown is which biological prerequisite explains a difference between conditions or preparations. P11 asks whether a demonstrated capacity is used natively; P12 distinguishes temporal consequences. Cofactors, partners and nutrient access are biological operands, not extra slots or execution-resource forecasts. Available records may leave the prerequisite unresolved.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 1999 Results and experimental descriptions; 2010 main Results/Methods Summary and figure captions; live AJ224978.1 metadata verified LT2 ttr locus, 12,121 bp. No raw LC-MS or animal reanalysis.
evidence.observation: Systemic nonphenotype contrasts with intestinal benefit, tetrathionate measurements and host-context perturbations.
evidence.limit: No animal or chemical experiment was repeated.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Main Results and figure/method descriptions; no nitrate chemistry or animal experiment repeated. Cofactor moaA phenotype alone was not taken as nitrate-specific evidence.
evidence.observation: Nos2 loss or iNOS inhibition removed the nitrate-respiration advantage despite inflammation.
evidence.limit: Combined reductase mutants do not isolate each paralog.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Relevant purification, reconstitution, activity/complementation methods, cofactor results and EPR interpretation inspected; raw spectra not reprocessed.
evidence.observation: Iron/sulfide alone failed; cobalamin addition restored oQ-to-Q conversion in reconstituted QueG.
evidence.limit: Assay reductants do not identify native electron delivery.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2012 Results/Methods; 2016 MeDH Results/growth/glassware/assay methods and ExaF Results, tables and assay details. Published curves/tables inspected; no numerical raw OD data reanalysis.
evidence.observation: Metal-conditioned growth required protein identity, metal-content and activity evidence to support lanthanide-dependent oxidation.
evidence.limit: Metal rescue alone would not distinguish regulation from catalysis.

options.name: Separate physical access from chemical competence
options.description: Explain a missing cellular reaction by contrasting inaccessible substrate/partner, absent substrate, failed catalyst and failed reporter delivery. Prefer changes that discriminate the relevant barrier.
options.use_when: Isolated capability disagrees with cellular function or a compartment-specific readout disappears.
live_alternatives: Catalyst is competent but cannot contact its substrate/partner.
Substrate is missing or sequestered on the wrong side.
Reporter fails to reach/detect available substrate.
Catalyst itself is defective.
decision_guidance: Name the barrier and entities whose contact is disputed; fractionation alone cannot settle it.
Different barriers/targeting regions are separate alternatives; global disruption does not identify every native route.
Relocation or targeting contrasts can test whether partner/compartment access changes the supported outcome.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Removing one barrier fails but exposing across another restores the readout
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Narrow the access explanation while retaining reporter controls.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Export/cleavage succeeds but native output fails
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Only upstream access is established; downstream compatibility can become P15.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Only prediction or growth is available
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Keep access provisional; neither establishes direct flux or orientation.

options.boundary: The unknown is a contact barrier between a competent catalyst, substrate, partner or reporter. P08 concerns other enabling prerequisites; P15 accepts an upstream event and asks what additional compatibility separates it from downstream success. Membrane association or a topology prediction alone does not establish transport, orientation or flux.

evidence.source_locator: Figs. 1–3 and final Results, chemical-genetic and barrier controls.
evidence.observation: Outer-membrane removal failed to restore ColM cleavage after MurJ inhibition; inner-membrane disruption restored it.
evidence.limit: Residual FtsW remained a caveat; no experimental repetition.

evidence.source_locator: Results Figs. 2–6,8 and functional-fusion controls.
evidence.observation: Export, targeting and catalysis separated; induced exported AmiC lacking septal concentration could suppress chaining.
evidence.limit: Induction rescue does not establish native targeting dispensability.

evidence.source_locator: 2000 reconstructed-genotype, DsbB-dependence and mixed-disulfide Results; Figs. 1–2 and Table 2.
evidence.observation: Exported TrxA supported oxidation with DsbB dependence, showing that changed access can alter direction.
evidence.limit: Engineered export is not a native exported-TrxA annotation.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2000 complete substrate-specificity, deletion-control and complementation Results/Discussion plus Methods descriptions; 1999 biochemical abstract only. 1996 discovery paper is a separate abstract-level lead.
evidence.observation: Some TauD-reactive compounds entered through SsuABC, separating enzyme and intact-cell substrate boundaries.
evidence.limit: Transport and desulfonation are different author-measured contributions.

options.name: Account for the coupled chemical system
options.description: Choose an explicit account of matter, electrons, cofactors and energy needed for a conversion. Reopen incomplete boundaries when an isolated reaction is implausible or replacement changes metabolic demand.
options.use_when: Output conflicts with a redox/stoichiometric account, or routes with the same product may require different support.
live_alternatives: A consumed partner or favorable coupled reaction is missing.
Partial uncoupling or another conversion alters the account.
Same output hides changed input/cofactor recycling demand.
Chemistry remains unsupported under stated assumptions.
decision_guidance: Choose the boundary and track relevant atoms/electrons/cofactors before calculating.
Kinetic activation does not supply missing thermodynamic driving force.
Keep measured balances distinct from ideal fully coupled ratios and preserve unknown potentials/recovery.
Use route-specific demands to identify which biological comparison distinguishes apparent output equivalence.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: A coupled account resolves the isolated energy deficit
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain feasibility under assumptions; occurrence requires separate evidence (P11).

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Measured ratio differs from the ideal
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Preserve measurement and consider uncoupling/incomplete recovery.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Replacement changes a recycled product/cofactor
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Expose the changed demand instead of asserting full interchangeability.

options.boundary: The episode chooses the biological reaction boundary and missing coupled chemistry; a calculator only evaluates the selected account. P06 asks who supplies the output, P07 asks what rescue restores, and P11 asks whether a feasible account is used. Standard-potential feasibility is not measured cellular free energy or native flux; no credit weight is supplied.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Full relevant introduction, purification/assay methods, results, tables and discussion inspected; raw HTML and parsed paragraphs saved.
evidence.observation: Low-potential ferredoxin output needs the crotonyl-CoA reduction account; measured H2-assay ratios differ from the fully coupled extrapolation.
evidence.limit: Illustrative standard-potential arithmetic is not measured intracellular free energy or the microscopic mechanism.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Relevant expression/reconstitution/assay methods, results, stoichiometry figures and discussion inspected; supplements not independently reanalyzed.
evidence.observation: Reactant/product stoichiometry supports coupled transhydrogenation rather than NAD+ allostery alone.
evidence.limit: Reversibility does not establish physiological direction.

evidence.source_locator: Table 2 and Figs. 3–4; replacement route-bookkeeping trace.
evidence.observation: ThyA imposes folate recycling demand; ThyA plus FolA restored growth better than ThyA alone.
evidence.limit: Donor assumptions remain explicit; authors’ simulations were inspected, not rerun.

evidence.source_locator: Primary Figs. 3–9; replacement/raw/route_bookkeeping_probe.json.
evidence.observation: BioZ and BioC/BioH carbon-entry accounts expose different reaction and reducing-step boundaries.
evidence.limit: Four versus two reducing steps is not four versus two NADPH; upstream costs stay outside the declared boundary.

options.name: Distinguish a possible route from the route actually used
options.description: Keep feasibility or measured capacity separate from native use. Contrast ordinary use, conditional backup, side activity and unused capacity without forcing a single-role explanation.
options.use_when: A reaction, model, structure or environmental gene detection is being promoted to main native role or actual flux.
live_alternatives: Capacity supplies the proposed native contribution.
It supplies a conditional backup/secondary role.
It is side activity or possible chemistry without demonstrated use.
Another route supplies the native output.
decision_guidance: Select observations with different expected consequences for native use and mere capacity: endogenous products, demand-specific perturbations or competing routes.
Retain genuine earlier side activity when a better native role appears; compatible conditional roles need not be exclusive.
Compare plausible exposure/kinetics without inventing concentrations or native substrates.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Independent native observations agree
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Support use under those conditions, not total flux or exclusivity.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Only overexpression/high-dose/artificial activity is positive
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain bounded capacity with ordinary responsibility unresolved.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: A stronger native explanation is established
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Revise priority/scope without deleting genuine prior chemistry.

options.boundary: The unknown is native use of a demonstrated or feasible capacity, including conditional secondary roles. P08 asks which prerequisite enables an effect; P10 asks whether the coupled chemical account is feasible. These are discriminating explanations, not acceptance gates, and a source annotation cannot establish native use by itself.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2009 relevant whole results/discussion and reaction methods; 2014 primary main results, enzyme methods and relevant extended-data legends; 2020 accepted manuscript sequence, kinetics, structure and conclusion sections inspected. Supporting spectra/kinetic fits were not reanalyzed.
evidence.observation: Real SSA reduction coexists with stronger native sulfoglycolysis evidence and much higher SLA efficiency.
evidence.limit: An earlier secondary stress role is not categorically excluded; no flux recomputation.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Complete relevant main texts/methods. P. aeruginosa validation deletes folX, not folM; natural E. coli use of exported monapterin remains unresolved in this study.
evidence.observation: Perturbed-system DHFR rescue coexists with stronger monapterin-pathway evidence and substrate preference.
evidence.limit: Natural E. coli use of exported monapterin remained unresolved.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2024 relevant complete results/discussion and assay/genotype methods inspected; 2013 relevant regulation, competition and growth results inspected. Supplements not independently analyzed. Fresh public-record probe documented in raw/live_probe_summary.json.
evidence.observation: Direct PNP hydrolysis plus native load/deletion contrasts supports conditional protection, not primary normal-state catabolism.
evidence.limit: Established sugar-stress participation is retained.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Main purification/substrate/gene-identification/transcription Results and cultivation/assay Methods. GenBank AY322364 reported; no new field dechlorination or sequence analysis.
evidence.observation: Activity-linked peptide identity supports VcrA; field vcrAB DNA alone is capacity evidence, not field flux.
evidence.limit: Partial purification and absence of knockout retain assignment limits.

options.name: Compare biological consequences over the time that matters
options.description: Choose time/phase contrasts distinguishing transient acceleration, repeated function, adaptation and survival. An early benefit or first product need not predict later outcomes.
options.use_when: Interpretation depends on when an effect appears, how long function is needed or whether operation must repeat.
live_alternatives: Effect is durably beneficial.
Early acceleration carries a later maintenance/survival cost.
First event succeeds but repeated operation fails.
Original observation window missed the relevant phase.
decision_guidance: Choose intervals from biological alternatives rather than a universal cadence.
Keep lag, growth, viability and repeated turnover as distinct outcomes.
Preserve differing early/late conclusions and investigate explanations that predict both.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Recovery improves but later survival falls
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Represent both outcomes in their windows.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: One product forms but repeated turnover fails
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Narrow the missing contribution toward sustained operation.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: A later phase exposes a phenotype
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Restrict the early nonphenotype without pretending it observed the later result.

options.boundary: The competing explanations differ in phase, duration or repeated operation, rather than merely being measured at different times. P13 separates biological units or mixtures at a relevant resolution; P08 tests a prerequisite. A setting-and-time difference such as ex-vivo versus infection does not isolate a temporal effect. This supplies no execution timer or stopping rule.

evidence.source_locator: Recovery, heterogeneity, survival Results; organism/yeag/trace.json route 1.
evidence.observation: Mutant recovery lag was shorter after starvation, yet prolonged-starvation CFU survival was worse.
evidence.limit: No raw FCS/CFU reanalysis; internal 24 h/72 h follow-up inconsistency is preserved.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Complete relevant mutant/spectroscopy/growth Results and growth conditions. No new fluorescence-lifetime analysis.
evidence.observation: Quenching-defective cells initially grew quickly then bleached/declined under stringent iron deficiency/high light.
evidence.limit: Other iron/light states differ; no spectroscopy reanalysis.

evidence.source_locator: Single/multiple-turnover Results, Methods and Discussion, 2018.
evidence.observation: Single product and release occur without TsaE; repeated Thermotoga operation needs productive ATPase coupling.
evidence.limit: Different E. coli endpoint evidence remains unreconciled.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Relevant growth/urine/motility/CAUTI Results and protocols; no inference that ex-vivo nonphenotype disproves an in-host role.
evidence.observation: Six-hour ex-vivo urine nonphenotype contrasts with 96-hour infection fitness loss.
evidence.limit: Both biological setting and duration change, so this is not an isolated time experiment.

options.name: Resolve an aggregate claim at the biological level that separates explanations
options.description: Ask whether pooled change reflects uniform effects, selective subsets or changed mixtures. Choose biologically meaningful units whose contrasts separate those explanations.
options.use_when: A population, protein or process label pools outcomes with potentially different biological meanings.
live_alternatives: Units change similarly.
A subset changes while others retain function.
Mixture/baseline changes rather than each unit’s response.
Missing/censored/differently normalized measurements leave quantification open.
decision_guidance: Choose resolution from the competing biological explanations, not just because finer data exist.
Compare affected/retained units while preserving baseline versus response and readout definition.
When needed resolution was not measured, qualify the aggregate claim rather than impute cell fates, occupancy or missing values.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Retained units contradict uniform loss
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Bound dependence to the affected subset.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Distributions differ beyond a simple average shift
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain heterogeneous-state explanations; fate needs independent evidence.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Site/condition records do not support pooling
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Return separate records; missing ratios are not zero abundance.

options.boundary: The competing explanations differ across biologically meaningful units or mixtures, not simply across more rows in a table. P12 contrasts phases or repeated operation. Record identity and normalization remain prerequisites for either pattern; finer extraction alone is a tool task and a changed phosphosite does not establish direct catalysis.

evidence.source_locator: Gated distributions and flow Methods; organism/yeag/trace.json route 1.
evidence.observation: WT and mutant recovery had different GFP distributions, making a uniform population-shift explanation inadequate.
evidence.limit: GFP is a proxy; no joint cell-lineage/survival data.

evidence.source_locator: Phospho sites table rows 3–6,53,128; workbook_probe in organism/yeag/trace.json.
evidence.observation: Actual XLSX extraction separated AceA sites and response ratios from occupancy, exposing incompatible records under a pooled AceA label.
evidence.limit: Selected descriptive rows, unequal replicate coverage, no raw spectra or zero imputation.

evidence.source_locator: Selected RNA Results; recorded GEO extraction in cellular/detailed_traces.json.
evidence.observation: Selected processing ends fell while rnpB behaved differently from rny loss, limiting uniform RNase Y dependence.
evidence.limit: Processed tracks are descriptive and do not resolve the historical mechanism disagreement.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Full Results examined, including specificity controls and rescue. Same protein-family investigation group as cellular_ybeY; not independent replication of all E. coli claims.
evidence.observation: 16S3-prime processing changed while other tested rRNA ends stayed normal.
evidence.limit: A selected end panel is not all RNA processing.

options.name: Distinguish the transformation from its proxy readout
options.description: Treat bands, cofactor changes, substrate loss and downstream signals as compatible with several transformations. Prefer evidence separating intended chemistry from half-reactions, spontaneous conversion or artifacts.
options.use_when: A proxy is naming a reaction without establishing what actually changed.
live_alternatives: Proxy reflects identified intended product.
A half-reaction/alternative creates the same proxy.
A spontaneous downstream step follows different enzyme chemistry.
Disappearance/migration changes without productive conversion.
decision_guidance: Name rival transformations before selecting product, labeling, temporal or chemical-competence evidence.
Keep genuine partial chemistry when full product is absent.
Structural plausibility can guide discrimination but cannot identify the chemistry alone.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Identified products/labeled atoms distinguish the event
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Assign that transformation at tested scope.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Proxy persists without expected product
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Reopen partial/alternative chemistry.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Only disappearance or band shift is observed
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Record it specifically; productive synthesis stays open.

options.boundary: The disputed relation is what transformation occurred, including whether a proxy reflects a half-reaction or spontaneous downstream event. P06 instead asks who caused an established output; P03 compares recognized candidate inputs. Product-identifying author experiments are source evidence, not newly available wet-lab actions.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Relevant indexed primary results/limitations inspected; no new experiments.
evidence.observation: PLP-to-PMP conversion lacked expected glutamate; phosphate elimination limited a PSAT conclusion.
evidence.limit: Physiological-direction substrate was unavailable; trapping remained proposed.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary sequence-analysis methods/results, abstract and product-analysis conclusion inspected; no new sequence search or biochemical experiment.
evidence.observation: Isobutene followed spontaneous decomposition after phosphorylation rather than direct enzymatic decarboxylation.
evidence.limit: No new product assay.

evidence.source_locator: Integration/disintegration and3-prime-OH Results; C4 in causal/cas2/case_trace.json.
evidence.observation: Radiolabel and disintegration controls separate covalent integration from plasmid topoisomer migration including BandX.
evidence.limit: Defined assays do not recapitulate every cellular repair/acquisition step.

evidence.source_locator: YihS product Results and relevant figure legends, 2021; specificity record yihs.3.
evidence.observation: NMR, isotope exchange and authentic reference identified an additional sulforhamnose product instead of assuming one isomerization product.
evidence.limit: Supporting spectra were not independently reprocessed.

options.name: Hold upstream success while investigating downstream failure
options.description: Preserve demonstrated recognition, binding, cleavage or delivery when productive output fails. Compare the additional compatibility or coupling explanations rather than repeat upstream positives.
options.use_when: Binding/processing is being treated as sufficient for catalysis, assembly, regulation or organismal output.
live_alternatives: Upstream engagement is sufficient here.
Another structural/chemical/partner constraint blocks progression.
Upstream readout differs or was misidentified.
Downstream measurement is incompetent.
decision_guidance: Seek contrasts with upstream competence but differing downstream outcomes.
Separate unexpressed constructs from expressed/processed variants.
If progression remains unexplained, return separated outcomes instead of inventing a mechanism.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Both substrates bind but only one converts
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Narrow productive recognition beyond binding.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Expressed processed variant fails assembly
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Support an additional compatibility requirement without assigning its mechanism.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Only upstream event is known
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Leave final role unresolved.

options.boundary: The accepted starting evidence establishes an upstream event while the downstream outcome differs or remains unknown. P09 disputes physical contact; P17 requires selective causal perturbation with retained alternative properties. P15 can preserve a downstream unknown without isolating its cause; no recognize–process–assemble itinerary follows.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary PNAS abstract plus NAR substrate-preparation methods and Q34 comparison results inspected. No live tRNA or protein calculation.
evidence.observation: Both Q-containing/lacking tRNA-Asp bound YadB, but only Q-containing substrate was glutamylated.
evidence.limit: Matched tests are author-performed; binding alone does not locate the modified atom.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2012 comparative alignment and tRNA-analysis results plus 2017 substrate/adduct methods and discussion inspected through indexed primary text. No new enzyme experiments.
evidence.observation: Free preQ0 and preQ0-tRNA formed adducts; productive synthesis used tRNA-bound precursor.
evidence.limit: Physiological ammonia-delivery partner remained open.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Full primary text and live 1MJH contact record checked; published answer known.
evidence.observation: Retained ATP coexisted with little isolated ATPase; native extract enabled hydrolysis.
evidence.limit: The enabling factor and cellular role remained unknown.

evidence.source_locator: Figs. 8–9 and hybrid Results; spatial/archaeal_processing/investigation.json B2.
evidence.observation: Expressed, processed PilA1 hybrid lacked pili/adhesion; an unexpressed PilA3 hybrid could not support that same conclusion.
evidence.limit: No native packing or specific interaction mechanism established.

options.name: Distinguish direct input action from indirect response and feedback
options.description: Environmental responses can arise through direct ligand recognition, cofactor chemistry, changed abundance or system-demand feedback. Choose contrasts distinguishing those routes before assigning a direct sensor or regulatory sign.
options.use_when: Induction, binding or physiology is being treated as proof of direct signal recognition.
live_alternatives: Input binds the regulator.
Input changes a cofactor/state without selective ligand binding.
Partner demand/feedback mediates the response.
Abundance or another regulator explains it.
decision_guidance: Keep signal, molecular state, amount, DNA recognition and productive regulation distinct.
Choose contrasts controlling the relevant alternatives, including target classes and feedback demand.
Direct binding addresses recognition; promoter binding alone proves neither signal binding nor transcriptional sign.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Purified protein binds input with informative controls
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Support assay-specific binding without claiming the whole native mechanism.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: State controls distinguish cofactor chemistry from feedback
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain compatible supported routes; do not call a chemical input a selective ligand.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Response is known but direct action untested
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Report response with sensing route unresolved.

options.boundary: The disputed relation is how a biological input reaches a regulatory response, not general response correlation or component attribution. P06 assigns contribution to an established system output; P08 asks which prerequisite enables function. Direct ligand binding, cofactor chemistry and feedback are different explanations; promoter binding alone supplies neither input sensing nor transcriptional sign.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Indexed complete relevant regulatory Results, transport Discussion, figure descriptions and culture/purification Methods inspected. Direct publisher fetch 403; raw binding data not obtained. Current published 2026 article used, not 2025 preprint.
evidence.observation: Repression tests and direct 5-OP ITC with competitors establish different parts of the sensing/control claim.
evidence.limit: Growth rescue of pxpT did not measure purified transport.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Relevant Results including deletion, reporter rescue and sugar-independent DNA binding; growth/deletion/purification Methods inspected.
evidence.observation: Promoter binding and maltose-utilization regulation coexisted with no maltose-induced EMSA change.
evidence.limit: Direct maltose sensing was not established.

evidence.source_locator: Figs. 1–6 and relevant redox/binding/reporter Results; I9–I12 in root/regulatory_specificity/case_trace.json.
evidence.observation: PMS/state and target controls separate anaerobic redox effects from cluster loss and indirect Fe-S-demand explanations.
evidence.limit: No selective PMS pocket or complete intracellular state trajectory was measured.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Complete genomic reconstruction, dual-function results, evolutionary caveats, and relevant bioinformatics/DNA-binding/kinase methods read. Structure section not exhaustively inspected; no motif scan or assay repeated.
evidence.observation: FMN disrupted fusion-protein DNA binding; operator placement suggested but did not measure activation.
evidence.limit: Do not convert site geometry into observed transcriptional sign.

options.name: Separate linked functions through selective dissociation
options.description: Seek comparisons preserving one property while changing another. Use their dissociation to distinguish a required functional relation from amount, delivery, stability or another linked activity.
options.use_when: A mutant phenotype is assigned to one molecular function despite several potentially affected properties.
live_alternatives: Named function is required.
Amount/localization/assembly/another function explains the effect.
Distinct connections jointly contribute but can reside on different molecules.
The measured activity and native role dissociate.
decision_guidance: Prefer positive evidence that alternative properties survive; a failed construct is not automatically selective.
Reciprocal/complementary contrasts are informative when their predicted results differ, without requiring them universally.
Keep incomplete perturbation validation as a limit rather than claiming a specific null from its label.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Function fails despite retained amount/delivery
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Exclude simple instability/mislocalization without inventing direct binding.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Complementary defects restore function but same-defect controls do not
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Support joint contribution of distinct connections.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Endpoint survives a supposed catalytic-null mutation without null validation
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Do not infer catalytic dispensability from the label.

options.boundary: The contrast must preserve relevant alternative properties while perturbing a proposed causal relation. P02 can use natural feature/function discordance without causal selectivity; P15 can preserve successful upstream and failed downstream events without isolating the cause. Ordinary suppression is not reciprocal separation-of-function evidence; mutagenesis is not an available operation merely because a case reports it.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Primary full Results examined, including mutant fold/function controls and the mixed-complex repair experiment.
evidence.observation: DnaA- or DnaN-interaction defects complemented in trans with same-defect controls, restoring foci/initiation control.
evidence.limit: The result does not settle every molecular YabA model.

evidence.source_locator: Primary Table 1 and functional/localization Results; EnvC detailed trace.
evidence.observation: Stable septally localized variants lost cell separation and AmiB activation.
evidence.limit: The proposed direct helix interaction remained uncaptured.

evidence.source_locator: Switch-mutant/turnover Results, Methods and Discussion, 2019.
evidence.observation: Switch variants retained ATPase yet lost efficient repeated t6A synthesis.
evidence.limit: Tested Thermotoga result does not resolve the E. coli endpoint comparison.

evidence.source_locator: Primary abstract only, 2000; inspection boundary in specificity case record.
evidence.observation: Active heterologous IMPases failed rescue while inactive native D87N retained it.
evidence.limit: This 2000 comparison was abstract-only; later rRNA/Nus results were inspected more fully.

options.name: Explain conflicting biological results with discriminating scope contrasts
options.description: Compare incompatible biological claims by testing whether a difference in organism, molecular state, assay window, relation or construct predicts the disagreement. Preserve genuine conflict when available observations do not distinguish the explanations.
options.use_when: Studies or assays appear to support incompatible assignments or dependencies.
live_alternatives: Results genuinely conflict under comparable conditions.
Both hold in different states/organisms/windows.
A proxy has been given a stronger interpretation.
A specific construct or record error explains a result.
decision_guidance: State the incompatible biological relations and the matching conditions needed for a real contradiction; source identity does not decide which relation is correct.
Seek evidence testing the proposed explanation, not just metadata differences.
Plausible scope differences are not resolutions until a discriminating comparison exists.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: A corrected construct/condition is linked to the discrepancy
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Revise only the interpretation supported by the correction.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Scope explanation remains untested
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Retain conflict and the missing comparison.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Records concern different outputs/phases
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Restrict claims without calling them equivalent replications.

options.boundary: The starting evidence contains incompatible biological claims at apparently comparable scope; the problem is to test an explanation for the disagreement. P04 revises a failed attachment within one explanation. Organism, condition or construct differences are candidate explanations, not automatic resolutions. This is not a publication search, paper-ranking or literature-reading process, and no observation or saved credit is rewritten.

evidence.source_locator: Reported disagreement/strain effects; three-paper comparison in cellular detailed trace.
evidence.observation: One study disputed the sinR explanation and reported strain-dependent phosphorelay effects while other data supported RNA-processing participation.
evidence.limit: Later selected RNA evidence did not resolve the direct-phosphorelay dispute.

evidence.source_locator: 2015 mutant Results/supplementary assays and 2018 discussion of unresolved comparison.
evidence.observation: E. coli endpoint formation despite low ATPase differed from Thermotoga repeated-turnover evidence, explicitly left unreconciled.
evidence.limit: Organism and assay differences are limits, not demonstrated solutions.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 1990 abstract plus complete relevant 2017 primary Results subsection read; conflicting conditions were not experimentally reconciled.
evidence.observation: A later K12 study found no temperature/media growth difference despite an earlier heat requirement.
evidence.limit: Older source was abstract-level; conditions were not experimentally reconciled.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2007 salvage relevant whole results and media methods; 2011 relevant dgt/yjjG comparisons, discussion and medium composition inspected. 2007 housecleaning primary abstract only; publisher PDF access failed.
evidence.observation: Later work reproduced salvage contribution in enriched medium but found little effect in unenriched minimal medium and an alternative dgt route.
evidence.limit: This bounds the phenotype rather than making salvage and housecleaning mutually exclusive.

options.name: Investigate the route behind residual function
options.description: Preserve reproducible output after a focal loss while distinguishing another contributor from incomplete perturbation, imported product or reduced demand. Revise exclusivity without erasing the lost route’s genuine contribution.
options.use_when: Knockout/depletion leaves growth, product or activity unaccounted for by the current explanation.
live_alternatives: Another contributor supplies residual output.
Perturbation is incomplete or a suppressor restores original activity.
Environmental supply or bypass reduces demand.
Residual readout is an artifact or different output.
decision_guidance: Choose a contrast within the residual-function background separating an alternative contributor from remaining original activity or supply.
Restoration/independent activity can clarify attribution without settling every native route/cofactor.
Combined perturbations are recorded evidence or candidate work, not an automatic requirement for new experiments.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Additional loss removes residual output and restoration recovers it
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Support overlap at measured scope, not universal exclusivity.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Output depends on supply or unremoved activity
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Restrict redundancy to the actual bypass/perturbation.

outcome_contingencies.if_observed: Residual route cannot be assigned
outcome_contingencies.then_consider: Return retained function with its source unknown.

options.boundary: The starting observation is reproducible output retained after a focal loss. P05 explains a missing assignment for a system requirement; P07 explains an improved endpoint after intervention. Residual function permits alternative contributors but does not identify them, and combined-gene evidence does not isolate every member.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: 2012 Results/Methods; 2016 MeDH Results/growth/glassware/assay methods and ExaF Results, tables and assay details. Published curves/tables inspected; no numerical raw OD data reanalysis.
evidence.observation: Residual mutant growth led to ExaF loss/restoration and independent activity rather than XoxF exclusivity.
evidence.limit: No cultures or raw growth-curve fitting repeated.

evidence.source_locator: 2017 DUF208 Is Needed, Fig. 3; replacement QueH trace.
evidence.observation: Single deletions retained Q; double loss accumulated oQ and lost Q.
evidence.limit: Cellular overlap does not settle isolated catalysis, metal or donor.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Full 2017 methods/results page inspected, including genetic, sequence and structural sections. 2014 primary abstract inspected. No new sequence calculation or wet-lab work.
evidence.observation: hisN loss retained slow growth; cg0911 overexpression rescued but native loss did not explain the residual.
evidence.limit: Residual native route remained unresolved; side activity was not native responsibility.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record observation; inspected scope: Published full Results and lipid/depletion controls examined. The separate 2023 preprint was identified and excluded from published-case evidence.
evidence.observation: Combined AsmA-like depletion exposed lethal envelope/lipid-partition defects masked in simpler backgrounds.
evidence.limit: Physiological overlap is supported; direct purified net transport is not established.
